entities.summary: Basharmal Sultani is an Afghan Olympic athlete, who competed in boxing in the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece. He was invited to participate by the International Olympic Committee. He lost his first round bout in the welterweight category to Mohamed Hikal of Egypt on points, 40–12.
